name: WMT (Workshop on Machine Translation) shared-task datasets
description: A collection of datasets and evaluation resources released for the annual Workshop on Machine Translation shared tasks, covering machine translation across multiple language pairs and task settings.
citation: Bojar, O., Chatterjee, R., Federmann, C., et al. (2016). Findings of the 2016 Conference on Machine Translation. Proceedings of the First Conference on Machine Translation: Volume 2, Shared Task Papers. https://aclanthology.org/W16-2301/

license.notes: WMT shared tasks aggregate datasets, translated material, and evaluation resources with potentially different licenses and access terms; there is no single license covering all releases. Consult the specific task's documentation and underlying source-data terms before use or redistribution.
